artworks.title: Teucer
artworks.description: Thornycroft's Teucer — the Telamonian archer whose exile after Ajax's death sends him to found Salamis in Cyprus.

artworks.title: Statue of an Archer from the West Pediment of the Temple of Aphaia (traditionally identified as Teucer)
artworks.description: The Aphaia pediment archer — traditionally identified as Teucer, the bastard brother who outlives Ajax and loses Telamon's hall.

artworks.title: Teucer with Seated Heracles (amethyst intaglio)
artworks.description: A Roman intaglio of Teucer with seated Heracles — the hero whose Cypriot foundation keeps Telamon's line alive overseas.

popCulture.title: Teucer
popCulture.description: Ajax's half-brother, best archer of the host — banished from Salamis, founder of a new Salamis on Cyprus.

popCulture.title: Ajax (Sophocles)
popCulture.creator: Sophocles
popCulture.description: Sophocles' Ajax already foreshadows Teucer's exile — Telamon's rage if the half-brother comes home without Ajax.

popCulture.title: Salamis, Cyprus
popCulture.description: The Cypriot city claimed Teucer's bow as its foundation myth — exile turned into a second Salamis.
